README: The institution profile: what makes an install 'ours'. It supplies the
DEFAULTS behind config/settings.json — what a first launch starts from,
and what 'Reset to default branding' restores.
THIS file is the shipped example and is deliberately neutral: it names
no institution, so a fresh install of the suite belongs to nobody until
someone says otherwise. To set an institution up, copy a filled-in
profile to config/profile.json (see profiles/ for a ready-made one) and
restart the shell; config/ is gitignored, so your copy stays local.
Everything here can also be edited in the UI (splash Step 1 and the
Settings page) — the profile is only what those start from.
NOT here on purpose: the Crossref DEPOSIT IDENTITY (depositor name and
email, registrant, publisher). A deposit credited to the wrong
organization is hard to notice and awkward to undo, so it is never a
default — set it in Settings > Crossref deposit identity.
